title: Rebuilding Better Together — 2026 Annual Theme Celebration
thematicFocus: Ephesians 4:16 — Every joint supplying growth and edifying the body in love.
lyricsSnippet: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth.

title: Welcome to The Relaunch — Stepping Into Divine Momentum
thematicFocus: Isaiah 43:19 — Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth.
lyricsSnippet: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

title: Sunday Worship Encounter & Word of Truth
thematicFocus: Consecrated worship, the presence of the Lord, and biblical kingdom doctrine.
lyricsSnippet: God is a Spirit: and they that worship Him must worship Him in spirit and in truth.

title: YoungFire Youth & Young Adult Ignition Gathering
thematicFocus: Setting this generation on holy fire; unashamed kingdom courage in modern culture.
lyricsSnippet: PRAY. GROW. SERVE. IMPACT. Standing firm in the 66 Holy Scripture books.

title: Altar Fire: The Power of Persistent Intercession
thematicFocus: Leviticus 6:13 — The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
lyricsSnippet: Rekindling corporate prayer and tearing down spiritual strongholds over our families and city.

title: Praise (feat. Brandon Lake, Chris Brown & Chandler Moore)
thematicFocus: Psalm 150 — Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord!
lyricsSnippet: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord! I praise in the valley, I praise on the mountain!

title: Graves Into Gardens (feat. Brandon Lake)
thematicFocus: Ezekiel 37 — God turning graves into gardens, bones into armies.
lyricsSnippet: You turn mourning to dancing, You give beauty for ashes, You turn graves into gardens!

title: Jireh (feat. Chandler Moore & Naomi Raine)
thematicFocus: Genesis 22:14 & Matthew 6 — Jehovah Jireh, God our complete Provider.
lyricsSnippet: Jireh, You are enough! I will be content in every circumstance, You are enough!

title: Trust In God (feat. Chris Brown)
thematicFocus: Blessed Assurance hymn celebration combined with contemporary declaration.
lyricsSnippet: I sought the Lord and He heard and He answered! That is why I trust Him, that is why I trust in God!

title: RATTLE! (Official Live Video)
thematicFocus: Resurrection power of Christ bringing dead situations back to life.
lyricsSnippet: Dry bones hear the word of the Lord! Live, live, live! Rattle in Jesus name!

title: O Come to the Altar (Official Live Video)
thematicFocus: Altar call invitation to lay down brokenness and receive grace.
lyricsSnippet: Are you hurting and broken within? Overwhelmed by the weight of your sin? Jesus is calling!

title: Do It Again (Official Live Video)
thematicFocus: Faith in God faithfulness: Your promise still stands, great is Your faithfulness.
lyricsSnippet: Walking around these walls, I thought by now they’d fall, but You have never failed me yet!

title: Promises (feat. Joe L. Barnes & Naomi Raine)
thematicFocus: Faithful from age to age; God covenant keeping nature.
lyricsSnippet: Great is Your faithfulness to me! From the rising sun to the setting same, I will praise Your name!

title: Wait On You (feat. Dante Bowe & Chandler Moore)
thematicFocus: Isaiah 40:31 — They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
lyricsSnippet: They that wait on the Lord shall renew their strength, they shall mount up with wings as eagles!

title: Fear Is Not My Future (feat. Brandon Lake & Chandler Moore)
thematicFocus: Declaring goodbye to fear, depression, and anxiety in the power of Jesus name.
lyricsSnippet: Fear is not my future, sickness is not my story, heartbreak is not my home!

title: Man of Your Word (feat. Chandler Moore & KJ Scriven)
thematicFocus: Numbers 23:19 — God is not a man that He should lie.
lyricsSnippet: All things are possible, if You said it, it’s done! You are a Man of Your word!

title: Goodness of God (Live)
thematicFocus: Lifetime testimony of God relentless goodness and steadfast love.
lyricsSnippet: All my life You have been faithful, all my life You have been so so good!

title: Believe For It (Live)
thematicFocus: Supernatural healing and miracle faith over impossible situations.
lyricsSnippet: They say this mountain can’t be moved, they say these chains will never break, but they don’t know You!

title: Holy Forever (Live)
thematicFocus: Revelation 4 & 5 — The song of ages echoing the angels crying Holy.
lyricsSnippet: A thousand generations falling down in worship to sing the song of ages to the Lamb!

title: That’s My King (Live)
thematicFocus: Proclaiming the majesty, authority, and lordship of King Jesus.
lyricsSnippet: Who is the King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty! That’s my King!

title: Gratitude (Live from The Loft)
thematicFocus: Humble gratitude: So I throw up my hands and praise You again and again.
lyricsSnippet: All You want is an offering of a hallelujah! Come on my soul, oh don’t you get shy, lift up your song!

title: LION (feat. Chris Brown)
thematicFocus: The Lion of Judah roaring with authority and breaking every chain.
lyricsSnippet: Hail, hail the Lion of Judah! Let the Lion roar!

title: PRAIRIE (Official Music Video)
thematicFocus: Youthful energy, energetic praise, running free in the grace of God.
lyricsSnippet: High energy young adult anthem rejoicing in the wide-open meadows of grace.

title: Goodbye Yesterday (Official Lyric Video)
thematicFocus: 2 Corinthians 5:17 — Old things have passed away, behold all things are become new.
lyricsSnippet: Goodbye yesterday, I’m stepping into the new day Jesus has prepared!

title: QUIET (Official Audio)
thematicFocus: Finding peace in God presence amid the noise of social media and modern life.
lyricsSnippet: Be still and know that I am God. Silencing the mental static in the secret place.

title: Growing Pains (Full Album Session)
thematicFocus: Young adults processing maturity, identity, and discipleship in modern culture.
lyricsSnippet: Every trial is producing endurance, building young fire in the faith.

title: Break Every Chain (Live)
thematicFocus: There is power in the name of Jesus to break every chain.
lyricsSnippet: There is power in the name of Jesus to break every chain, break every chain!

title: You Know My Name (feat. Jimi Cravity)
thematicFocus: He walks with me and He talks with me, He tells me I am His own.
lyricsSnippet: No one loves me like You do, no one knows me like You do! You know my name!

title: Revolution (Official Video)
thematicFocus: Youth revolution of righteousness, calling the church to bold street action.
lyricsSnippet: Do you want a revolution? Whoop whoop! Let the redeemed of the Lord say so!

title: Love Theory (Official Music Video)
thematicFocus: God unconditional love transforming broken people into vessels of joy.
lyricsSnippet: How can I explain it? He saved me and made me new!

title: Stomp (feat. God’s Property)
thematicFocus: Unapologetic celebration of joy and victory over the adversary.
lyricsSnippet: For the Lord is good and His mercy endureth forever! Stomp!

title: No Weapon Formed Against Me Shall Prosper
thematicFocus: Isaiah 54:17 — No weapon formed against thee shall prosper.
lyricsSnippet: No weapon formed against me shall prosper, it won’t work! God will do what He said He would do!

title: We’re Blessed (In the City, in the Field)
thematicFocus: Deuteronomy 28 covenant blessing on those who obey the voice of the Lord.
lyricsSnippet: Blessed in the city, blessed in the field, blessed going in and blessed coming out!

title: We Fall Down (Live)
thematicFocus: Proverbs 24:16 — A just man falleth seven times and riseth up again.
lyricsSnippet: We fall down, but we get up! For a saint is just a sinner who fell down and got up!

title: Stand (Live from London)
thematicFocus: Ephesians 6:13 — Having done all, to stand. Stand firm in faith.
lyricsSnippet: What do you do when you’ve done all you can and it seems like it’s never enough? Stand!

title: Anointed Gospel Saxophone Worship & Soaking (Secret Place)
thematicFocus: Secret Place Meditation & Pure Peaceful Instrumentals
lyricsSnippet: Warm acoustic saxophone chords with peaceful piano backing for deep prayer.

title: Gospel Saxophone & Piano: Goodness of God & Worship Medley
thematicFocus: Restful, atmosphere-shifting instrumental worship for quiet time with God.
lyricsSnippet: Gentle saxophone renditions of favorite contemporary and traditional gospel melodies.

title: Midnight Intercession: Pure Acoustic Davidic Harp & Strings
thematicFocus: 1 Samuel 16:23 — David taking the harp and soothing the atmosphere.
lyricsSnippet: Instrumental soaking atmosphere designed for nocturnal prayer watches and study.

title: Soulful Christian R&B & Gospel Worship 24/7
thematicFocus: Continuous 24/7 Watchstander Praise
lyricsSnippet: Continuous worship stream without interruption.

title: Christian Lo-Fi Beats to Pray & Study to 24/7
thematicFocus: Quiet Time & Bible Study Ambience
lyricsSnippet: Relaxing Christian lofi beats for focused scripture meditation.

title: Genesis 1–11: Creation, Fall & Human Rebellion
thematicFocus: Literary architecture of Genesis 1–11, human rebellion, the flood, and the promise of the seed.
lyricsSnippet: God creates a world of good order and beauty. Humanity chooses autonomy.

title: Genesis 12–50: The Covenant with Abraham
thematicFocus: God unconditional covenant with Abraham to bless all families through his lineage.
lyricsSnippet: Genesis 50:20: What man intended for evil, God orchestrated for redemptive good.

title: Exodus 1–18: Deliverance From Pharaoh & Passover
thematicFocus: Moses, the burning bush, Yahweh victory over Pharaoh, and parting of the Red Sea.
lyricsSnippet: The Lord will fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace. Exodus 14:14.

title: Exodus 19–40: The Covenant at Sinai & Tabernacle
thematicFocus: The Ten Commandments, the Golden Calf, and the Tabernacle where God dwells.
lyricsSnippet: The glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle. God dwelling among His redeemed people.

title: Leviticus: Holiness, Atonement & The High Priest
thematicFocus: How can sinful humans dwell near a holy God? Sacrifices, the Day of Atonement, and holy living.
lyricsSnippet: Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy. Leviticus 19:2.

title: Numbers: Rebellion in the Wilderness & God Faithfulness
thematicFocus: Israel 40-year journey through the wilderness, the bronze serpent, and Balaam prophecy.
lyricsSnippet: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: The Lord make his face shine upon thee. Numbers 6:24–26.

title: Deuteronomy: The Shema & Call to Covenant Love
thematicFocus: Moses final farewell address to the new generation before crossing into Canaan.
lyricsSnippet: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord. Love the Lord your God with all your heart.

title: Joshua: Be Strong & Courageous — Conquering the Land
thematicFocus: The Jordan River crossing, the fall of Jericho, and choosing this day whom ye will serve.
lyricsSnippet: Joshua 1:9 — Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed.

title: Judges: The Downward Spiral of Compromise
thematicFocus: The tragic cycle of rebellion, oppression, cry for help, and flawed deliverers.
lyricsSnippet: Every man did that which was right in his own eyes. The need for a righteous King.

title: Ruth: The Kinsman Redeemer & Hesed Love
thematicFocus: A foreign widow covenant loyalty (hesed) leading to Boaz and the lineage of King David.
lyricsSnippet: Ruth 1:16 — Whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge.

title: 1 Samuel: Saul, David & The Lord Anointed
thematicFocus: The transition from judges to monarchy. The contrast between Saul pride and David heart.
lyricsSnippet: Man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart. 1 Samuel 16:7.

title: 2 Samuel: David Reign & The Everlasting Covenant
thematicFocus: God covenant with David in 2 Samuel 7 promising an eternal kingdom fulfilled in Jesus.
lyricsSnippet: Thy house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee. 2 Samuel 7:16.

title: 1 & 2 Kings: Solomon, The Divided Kingdom & Exile
thematicFocus: Solomon temple, the division into Israel and Judah, Elijah ministry, and the tragic exile.
lyricsSnippet: A call to covenant fidelity; prophets calling rebellious kings back to Yahweh.

title: 1 & 2 Chronicles: The Hope of the Coming Son of David
thematicFocus: A retelling of Israel history for post-exilic returnees focusing on the temple and messianic promise.
lyricsSnippet: 2 Chronicles 7:14 — If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray.

title: Ezra & Nehemiah: Rebuilding the Temple & City Walls
thematicFocus: Zerubbabel, Ezra, and Nehemiah leading the return from Babylon to reconstruct Jerusalem.
lyricsSnippet: Nehemiah 8:10 — The joy of the Lord is your strength.

title: Esther: For Such a Time as This & Divine Providence
thematicFocus: God unspoken yet sovereign hand preserving His covenant people in the Persian empire.
lyricsSnippet: Esther 4:14 — Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

title: Job: Trusting God in Suffering & Cosmic Wisdom
thematicFocus: Why do the righteous suffer? Job wrestling with grief and God sovereign majesty.
lyricsSnippet: Job 19:25 — For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day.

title: Psalms: The Prayer Book of God People
thematicFocus: 150 inspired songs of lament, praise, thanksgiving, and messianic prophecy.
lyricsSnippet: Psalm 23: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures.

title: Proverbs: The Fear of the Lord is the Beginning of Wisdom
thematicFocus: Lady Wisdom versus Lady Folly. Practical guidance on money, words, integrity, and relationships.
lyricsSnippet: Proverbs 3:5–6 — Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

title: Ecclesiastes: The Meaning of Life & Hevel (Vapor)
thematicFocus: Life under the sun: the smoke of earthly pursuits and fearing God in the present moment.
lyricsSnippet: Ecclesiastes 12:13 — Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

title: Song of Solomon: The Passionate Poetry of Love
thematicFocus: Celebration of holy romantic intimacy and a portrait of divine passionate covenant.
lyricsSnippet: Song of Solomon 8:6 — For love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave.

title: Isaiah 1–39: Judgment, Holiness & The Holy Seed
thematicFocus: Isaiah vision of Yahweh on the throne and the prophecy of Immanuel and the Prince of Peace.
lyricsSnippet: Isaiah 9:6 — For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder.

title: Isaiah 40–66: Comfort, The Suffering Servant & New Creation
thematicFocus: Isaiah 53 prophecy of Christ suffering for our transgressions, and the new heavens and earth.
lyricsSnippet: Isaiah 53:5 — But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities.

title: Jeremiah: The Weeping Prophet & The New Covenant
thematicFocus: God judgment on idolatry, the potter clay, and the promise of the New Covenant written on the heart.
lyricsSnippet: Jeremiah 31:33 — I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts.

title: Lamentations: Mourning Jerusalem & Great is Thy Faithfulness
thematicFocus: Five poetic funeral laments over Jerusalem destruction, centered on God mercies new every morning.
lyricsSnippet: Lamentations 3:22–23 — It is of the Lord mercies that we are not consumed. Great is thy faithfulness.

title: Ezekiel 1–32: The Chariot Throne & Departing Glory
thematicFocus: Ezekiel surreal visions of God mobile chariot throne departing Jerusalem because of idolatry.
lyricsSnippet: Ezekiel 1:28 — This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord.

title: Ezekiel 33–48: The Valley of Dry Bones & New Temple
thematicFocus: Breath reviving dry bones, the good Shepherd, and water flowing from the restored sanctuary.
lyricsSnippet: Ezekiel 37:5 — Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.

title: Daniel: The Fiery Furnace, Lions Den & The Son of Man
thematicFocus: Staying faithful under imperial pressure; visions of the Ancient of Days and the eternal Kingdom.
lyricsSnippet: Daniel 7:13–14 — One like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven... an everlasting dominion.

title: Hosea: Scandalous Love & Unfaithful Israel
thematicFocus: Hosea marriage to Gomer illustrating Yahweh relentless, heartbroken pursuit of His bride.
lyricsSnippet: Hosea 6:6 — For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

title: Joel: The Locust Plague & The Outpouring of the Spirit
thematicFocus: The Day of the Lord, national repentance, and God promise to pour out His Spirit on all flesh.
lyricsSnippet: Joel 2:28 — I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy.

title: Amos: Let Justice Roll Down Like Waters
thematicFocus: The shepherd-prophet exposing religious hypocrisy and oppression of the poor.
lyricsSnippet: Amos 5:24 — But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

title: Obadiah: The Downfall of Edom Pride
thematicFocus: Judgment against Edom for violence against brother Jacob, and the restoration of Mount Zion.
lyricsSnippet: Obadiah 1:21 — And the kingdom shall be the Lord.

title: Jonah: The Runaway Prophet & Extravagant Grace
thematicFocus: Jonah flee to Tarshish, the great fish, and God astounding mercy to brutal Nineveh.
lyricsSnippet: Jonah 2:9 — Salvation is of the Lord.

title: Micah: To Do Justly, Love Mercy & Walk Humbly
thematicFocus: Indictment of corrupt leaders, the Bethlehem ruler prophecy, and doing justly.
lyricsSnippet: Micah 6:8 — What doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

title: Nahum: The Fall of Nineveh & Divine Justice
thematicFocus: Nineveh brutal empire facing God righteous retribution; good news to the oppressed.
lyricsSnippet: Nahum 1:7 — The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

title: Habakkuk: The Just Shall Live by His Faith
thematicFocus: A prophet honest wrestling with injustice, concluding in joyous trust even if the fig tree does not blossom.
lyricsSnippet: Habakkuk 2:4 — But the just shall live by his faith.

title: Zephaniah: The Day of the Lord & God Singing Over Us
thematicFocus: Purging fires of divine judgment leading to a humble remnant over whom God rejoices with singing.
lyricsSnippet: Zephaniah 3:17 — The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will joy over thee with singing.

title: Haggai: Rebuilding the Temple & Shaking the Nations
thematicFocus: Challenging returned exiles to prioritize rebuilding God house over their own paneled homes.
lyricsSnippet: Haggai 2:9 — The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts.

title: Zechariah: Not by Might, Nor by Power, But by My Spirit
thematicFocus: Visions of the four horsemen, the Branch, the humble King riding on a donkey, and the pierced one.
lyricsSnippet: Zechariah 4:6 — Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.

title: Malachi: Return to Me & The Sun of Righteousness
thematicFocus: Disputes with a cynical post-exilic nation; the promise of Elijah and the messenger of the covenant.
lyricsSnippet: Malachi 4:2 — But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings.

title: Matthew 1–13: The King & The Sermon on the Mount
thematicFocus: Jesus as the new Moses and rightful Son of David inaugurating the Kingdom of Heaven.
lyricsSnippet: Matthew 5:14 — Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

title: Matthew 14–28: The Upside-Down Kingdom & Great Commission
thematicFocus: Peter confession, Jesus passion and resurrection, and sending disciples to all nations.
lyricsSnippet: Matthew 28:19–20 — Go ye therefore, and teach all nations... and, lo, I am with you alway.

title: Mark: The Suffering Servant & The Son of God
thematicFocus: The fast-paced Gospel demonstrating Jesus authority over sickness, demons, and the cross.
lyricsSnippet: Mark 10:45 — For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

title: Luke 1–9: Good News to the Poor & The Magnificat
thematicFocus: Jesus birth announcements, the Spirit anointing at Nazareth, and mission to outcasts.
lyricsSnippet: Luke 4:18 — The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor.

title: Luke 10–24: The Road to Jerusalem & Emmaus Encounter
thematicFocus: The Good Samaritan, the Prodigal Son, the cross, and the risen Jesus opening the Scriptures.
lyricsSnippet: Luke 19:10 — For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

title: John 1–12: The Word Made Flesh & The Seven Signs
thematicFocus: In the beginning was the Word. Nicodemus, the woman at the well, and seven miraculous signs.
lyricsSnippet: John 1:14 — And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, and we beheld his glory.

title: John 13–21: The Upper Room & Resurrection Victory
thematicFocus: Jesus washing feet, the promise of the Holy Spirit, crucifixion, and restoring Peter.
lyricsSnippet: John 14:6 — I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

title: Acts 1–12: Pentecost & The Birth of the Church
thematicFocus: The Holy Spirit falling with fire, the early church koinonia fellowship, and Stephen martyrdom.
lyricsSnippet: Acts 1:8 — But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you.

title: Acts 13–28: Paul Missionary Journeys & Rome
thematicFocus: The Gospel penetrating the Roman Empire, the Jerusalem Council, and Paul bold preaching in chains.
lyricsSnippet: Acts 28:31 — Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ.

title: Romans 1–4: Justification by Faith Alone
thematicFocus: All have sinned; God righteousness revealed in Christ through faith, patterned after Abraham.
lyricsSnippet: Romans 1:16 — For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation.

title: Romans 5–16: Life in the Spirit & Living Sacrifices
thematicFocus: No condemnation, more than conquerors, God faithfulness to Israel, and walking in unity.
lyricsSnippet: Romans 8:28 — All things work together for good to them that love God.

title: 1 Corinthians: Unity, Spiritual Gifts & The Resurrection
thematicFocus: Addressing church divisions, sexual purity, spiritual gifts, and the supreme way of agape love.
lyricsSnippet: 1 Corinthians 13:13 — And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

title: 2 Corinthians: Strength Perfected in Weakness
thematicFocus: Ministry of reconciliation, earthen vessels holding heavenly treasure, and boasting in weakness.
lyricsSnippet: 2 Corinthians 12:9 — My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

title: Galatians: Freedom in Christ & The Fruit of the Spirit
thematicFocus: Defending the pure Gospel of grace against legalism; walking by the Spirit.
lyricsSnippet: Galatians 5:22–23 — But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith.

title: Ephesians: Our Identity in Christ & The Armor of God
thematicFocus: Chosen in Christ, one new humanity, holy walking, and putting on the whole armor of God.
lyricsSnippet: Ephesians 4:16 — Rebuilding better together, every joint supplying growth in love.

title: Philippians: The Mind of Christ & Joy in All Seasons
thematicFocus: Paul writing from prison: rejoicing in the Lord always, and Christ self-emptying kenosis.
lyricsSnippet: Philippians 4:13 — I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

title: Colossians: The Preeminence of Christ Over All Things
thematicFocus: Jesus as the image of the invisible God; setting your minds on things above.
lyricsSnippet: Colossians 1:18 — That in all things he might have the preeminence.

title: 1 Thessalonians: Living in Light of the Lord Return
thematicFocus: Steadfastness under persecution, holy sanctification, and comfort concerning Christ return.
lyricsSnippet: 1 Thessalonians 5:16–18 — Rejoice evermore. Pray without ceasing. In every thing give thanks.

title: 2 Thessalonians: Stand Fast & Do Not Grow Weary
thematicFocus: Clarifying the day of the Lord, exposing the man of lawlessness, and diligent labor.
lyricsSnippet: 2 Thessalonians 3:13 — But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

title: 1 Timothy: Church Leadership & Sound Doctrine
thematicFocus: Paul instructing young Timothy on pastoral care, qualifications of elders, and prayer.
lyricsSnippet: 1 Timothy 4:12 — Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers.

title: 2 Timothy: Fight the Good Fight & Guard the Deposit
thematicFocus: Paul final letter before martyrdom, charging Timothy to preach the word in season and out.
lyricsSnippet: 2 Timothy 1:7 — For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

title: Titus: Order in the Church & Good Works in Crete
thematicFocus: Appointing elders in every city, living with integrity, and making the Gospel attractive.
lyricsSnippet: Titus 2:11 — For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men.

title: Philemon: Reconciliation & Brotherhood in Christ
thematicFocus: Paul appealing to Philemon to receive runaway slave Onesimus back no longer as a slave, but as a beloved brother.
lyricsSnippet: Philemon 1:16 — Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved.

title: Hebrews: Jesus is Greater — The Supreme High Priest
thematicFocus: Jesus is greater than angels, Moses, and the Levitical priesthood. The Hall of Faith (Hebrews 11).
lyricsSnippet: Hebrews 12:1–2 — Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith.

title: James: Faith Without Works is Dead & Pure Religion
thematicFocus: Taming the tongue, joy in trials, caring for widows and orphans, and active, living faith.
lyricsSnippet: James 1:22 — But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

title: 1 Peter: Living Hope in the Midst of Suffering
thematicFocus: Chosen exiles, our royal priesthood, following Christ footsteps in suffering, and standing firm in grace.
lyricsSnippet: 1 Peter 2:9 — But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation.

title: 2 Peter: Add to Your Faith & The Day of the Lord
thematicFocus: Growing in godliness, warning against false teachers, and the certainty of Christ return.
lyricsSnippet: 2 Peter 3:9 — The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness.

title: 1, 2 & 3 John: God is Light & God is Love
thematicFocus: Walking in the light, abiding in Christ, loving the brethren, and overcoming the world.
lyricsSnippet: 1 John 4:18 — There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear.

title: Jude: Contending Earnestly for the Faith
thematicFocus: Vigorously defending the biblical faith against corrupt teachers, and the glorious doxology.
lyricsSnippet: Jude 1:24 — Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless.

title: Revelation 1–11: The Seven Churches & The Slain Lamb
thematicFocus: Letters to the seven churches, the throne room of heaven, and the Lion who conquered as a Lamb.
lyricsSnippet: Revelation 1:8 — I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord.

title: Revelation 12–22: The Final Victory & New Jerusalem
thematicFocus: The fall of Babylon, the marriage supper of the Lamb, and the New Jerusalem descending from heaven.
lyricsSnippet: Revelation 21:4 — And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death.

title: The BibleProject Podcast: Exploring God Image & Royal Priesthood
thematicFocus: Understanding the biblical theology of humans ruling and representing Yahweh in creation.
lyricsSnippet: Tim Mackie and Jon Collins unpack the identity of God royal priesthood from Genesis to Revelation.

title: The BibleProject Podcast: How the Apostles Read the Old Testament
thematicFocus: Literary patterns, typology, and how Jesus fulfilled every prophetic strand in the Tanakh.
lyricsSnippet: Looking at how Paul, Matthew, and the author of Hebrews interpreted ancient Hebrew Scripture.

title: Ask Pastor John: How Do I Overcome Secret Sins and Lust?
thematicFocus: Practical weapons of the Spirit: the Expulsive Power of a New Affection (Romans 8:13).
lyricsSnippet: John Piper gives razor-sharp biblical strategy for young adults battling digital and secret temptation.

title: Ask Pastor John: What Does It Mean to Die Daily to Self?
thematicFocus: Luke 9:23 and Galatians 2:20 — finding true joy by losing your life for Christ sake.
lyricsSnippet: Denying oneself is not self-hatred; it is trading finite fleeting idols for infinite divine satisfaction.

title: Ruslan KD: Christian Response to Secular Culture & Apologetics
thematicFocus: Engaging modern culture, music, and social issues through an uncompromising biblical worldview.
lyricsSnippet: Equipping young Christians to articulate truth without fear or anger in modern culture.

title: Ruslan KD: Why Young Adults Are Returning to Traditional Scripture
thematicFocus: The hunger among Gen Z and Millennials for deep discipleship over superficial entertainment.
lyricsSnippet: Examining the revival of orthodox theology and passionate prayer among the rising generation.

title: Vlad Savchuk Podcast: Breaking Spiritual Strongholds & Curses
thematicFocus: Deliverance ministry, renouncing generational bondage, and taking authority in Jesus name.
